verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents a CLI, a TUI, and a cookbook for exposing workflows as tools that external agent SDKs can call. None of these is a first-party way to operate Hatchet itself with natural-language commands. The agent-tools cookbook is a developer building block for building agents on top of Hatchet, and llms.txt is documentation for LLMs. Neither counts as a natural-language control interface, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
